# Chapala Theological Seminary

> A free bilingual (English/Spanish) online seminary offering self-study Bible and theology courses, at no cost, at the student's own pace. Based in Chapala, Jalisco, Mexico.

Chapala Theological Seminary (Seminario Teológico de Chapala) offers 44 courses in Bible, theology, preaching, pastoral ministry, counseling, and missions. Every course includes bilingual lessons (English and Spanish side by side) with a built-in review and a certificate on completion. Courses combine into four credential tracks: Certificate of Ministry (12 courses), Th.M. (12 courses including the 7 foundation courses), Associate of Divinity (25 courses), and Master of Divinity (30 courses, including a 20-course required core).

Founded by Dr. Wayne Cook (Th.D., New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary), who authored the seminary's curriculum. Directed by Dr. Ted Rogers (Ph.D.).

## Main pages

- [Home](https://chapalaseminary.org/index.html): Overview, faculty, and how to begin.
- [Course Catalog](https://chapalaseminary.org/CTSCatalog.html): All 44 courses, organized by foundation, M.Div. core, and electives.
- [About](https://chapalaseminary.org/CTSAbout.html): Mission, faculty, and location.
- [Program Requirements](https://chapalaseminary.org/CTSBeforeYouBegin.html): How courses combine into the seminary's four credential tracks.

## Notes

- All courses are free and self-paced; there is no enrollment fee.
- Every course is bilingual (English and Spanish).
- Course progress is saved locally in the student's browser; a backup tool is provided.
